bio.text: Horace Taylor is an independent candidate for U.S. House in Tennessee's 8th District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to his Ballotpedia profile, he served in the U.S. Army from 1981 to 2012 and works as an information technology professional.
The profile lists a bachelor's degree from the University of Memphis (1993) and a graduate degree from University of Maryland University College (2005), and says he attended Southside High School.
